mapper.select: SELECT od.ORDER_DETAIL_NO AS orderDetailNo, od.ORDER_NO AS orderNo, o.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, o.ORDER_STATUS AS orderStatus, o.ORDER_DATE AS orderDate, o.TOTAL_PRICE AS totalPrice, p.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, od.ORDER_QTY AS quantity, od.PRICE AS itemPrice, o.DELIVERY_FEE AS deliveryFee, pay.PAYMENT_METHOD AS paymentMethod, pm.CARD_COMPANY AS cardCompanyName, pm.BANK_CODE AS bankName, oa.REQUEST_MSG AS requestMsg, oa.ADDRESS AS address, oa.DETAIL_ADDRESS AS detailAddress, m.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName, m.PHONE AS phone, po.OPTION1_TYPE AS option1Type, po.OPTION1_VALUE AS option1Value, po.OPTION2_TYPE AS option2Type, po.OPTION2_VALUE AS option2Value, img.IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl FROM ORDERS o JOIN ORDER_DETAIL od ON o.ORDER_NO = od.ORDER_NO JOIN PRODUCT p ON od.PRODUCT_NO = p.PRODUCT_NO JOIN MEMBER m ON o.MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN ORDER_ADDRESS oa ON o.ORDER_ADDRESS_NO = oa.ORDER_ADDRESS_NO LEFT JOIN PAYMENT pay ON o.ORDER_NO = pay.ORDER_NO LEFT JOIN PAYMENT_METHOD pm ON pay.PAYMENT_METHOD_NO = pm.PAYMENT_METHOD_NO LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION po ON od.OPTION_ID = po.OPTION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_no, image_url FROM ( SELECT product_no, image_url, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY product_no ORDER BY image_no ASC) as rn FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE WHERE image_purpose = '대표' ) WHERE rn = 1 ) img ON p.PRODUCT_NO = img.PRODUCT_NO WHERE o.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} AND o.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY od.ORDER_DETAIL_NO ASC

SELECT ADDRESS_NO AS addressNo, MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, RECEIVER_NAME AS receiverName, TEL AS tel, ZIPCODE AS zipcode, ADDRESS AS address, DETAIL_ADDRESS AS detailAddress, REQUEST_MSG AS requestMsg, ADDRESS_DEFAULT AS addressDefault
FROM DELIVERY_ADDRESS
WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND ADDRESS_DEFAULT = 'Y'

SELECT ADDRESS_NO AS addressNo, MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, RECEIVER_NAME AS receiverName, TEL AS tel, ZIPCODE AS zipcode, ADDRESS AS address, DETAIL_ADDRESS AS detailAddress, REQUEST_MSG AS requestMsg, ADDRESS_DEFAULT AS addressDefault
FROM DELIVERY_ADDRESS
WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
ORDER BY ADDRESS_DEFAULT DESC, ADDRESS_NO DESC
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ORDER_ADDRESS ( ORDER_ADDRESS_NO, MEMBER_NO, RECEIVER_NAME, TEL, ZIPCODE, ADDRESS, DETAIL_ADDRESS, REQUEST_MSG )
SELECT #{orderAddressNo}, MEMBER_NO, RECEIVER_NAME, TEL, ZIPCODE, ADDRESS, DETAIL_ADDRESS, REQUEST_MSG
FROM DELIVERY_ADDRESS
WHERE ADDRESS_NO = #{addressNo} AND MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}

INSERT INTO ORDERS ( ORDER_NO, MEMBER_NO, CHECKOUT_NO, ORDER_DATE, DELIVERY_FEE, TOTAL_PRICE, ORDER_STATUS, ORDER_ADDRESS_NO, PRODUCT_AMOUNT, INSTANT_DISCOUNT, COUPON_DISCOUNT, CASH_USED )
SELECT #{orderNo}, MEMBER_NO, CHECKOUT_NO, SYSDATE, DELIVERY_FEE, TOTAL_PRICE, '결제완료', #{orderAddressNo}, PRODUCT_AMOUNT, INSTANT_DISCOUNT, COUPON_DISCOUNT, CASH_USED
FROM CHECKOUT
WHERE CHECKOUT_NO = #{checkoutNo} AND MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}

INSERT INTO PAYMENT ( PAYMENT_NO, ORDER_NO, PAYMENT_METHOD, PAYMENT_METHOD_NO, PAYMENT_AMOUNT, PAYMENT_STATUS, PAYMENT_DATE )
SELECT SEQ_PAYMENT_NO.NEXTVAL, #{orderNo}, #{paymentMethod}, #{paymentMethodNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, TOTAL_PRICE, 'PAID', SYSDATE
FROM CHECKOUT
WHERE CHECKOUT_NO = #{checkoutNo} AND MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}

INSERT INTO ORDER_DETAIL ( ORDER_DETAIL_NO, ORDER_NO, PRODUCT_NO, ORDER_QTY, PRICE, OPTION_ID )
SELECT SEQ_ORDER_DETAIL_NO.NEXTVAL, #{orderNo}, PRODUCT_NO, ORDER_QTY, PRICE, OPTION_ID
FROM CHECKOUT_ITEM
WHERE CHECKOUT_NO = #{checkoutNo}

SELECT d.RECEIVER_NAME AS receiverName,
d.TEL AS receiverPhone,
d.ZIPCODE AS zipcode,
TRIM( NVL(d.ADDRESS, '') || ' ' || NVL(d.DETAIL_ADDRESS, '') ) AS address,
d.REQUEST_MSG AS requestMsg,
TO_CHAR( o.ORDER_DATE + 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AS arrivalDate,
'주식회사 회사이름' AS sellerName,
NVL( o.PRODUCT_AMOUNT, 0 ) AS orderAmount,
( NVL(o.INSTANT_DISCOUNT, 0) + NVL(o.COUPON_DISCOUNT, 0) ) AS discountAmount,
NVL( o.DELIVERY_FEE, 0 ) AS shippingFee,
NVL( o.TOTAL_PRICE, 0 ) AS paymentAmount
FROM ORDERS o
JOIN ORDER_ADDRESS d ON o.ORDER_ADDRESS_NO = d.ORDER_ADDRESS_NO
WHERE o.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} AND o.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
